content.comment_body: Hello, I would like to use [product_name] for remote I/O in outdoor settings to collect and send data to actuators. What wireless options exist for connecting a central PLC ([version_no]) to [product_name] across distances of around 5km or more? Does anyone know a recommended modem for this? How can I exchange data between [product_name] units, such as via RS232? Any expert advice would be appreciated.
Hello, I suggest considering a MOXA WiFi converter: RS232 ([product_name]) to LAN (WiFi) PC.
That solution will not work with [product_name]. Here is a thread discussing how to communicate over LAN. Once that's successful locally, you can move on to wireless communication. [url]
This setup works well—I use it to communicate from home to my [product_name] at my shop, which is 300 meters away.
Could you share details about your hardware setup? Many users are asking about programming and reading data from [product_name] at a distance. Thanks in advance.

Hello, thank you for your attention. To clarify my project: I plan to use [product_name] with analog and digital I/Os as an RTU for outdoor use, and want to connect to it anytime using any available communication method (Ethernet LAN, UHF/VHF transceiver, etc.). The exact communication method is not important—my focus is on establishing connectivity. My main questions are: 1) How can I set up communication in programming with [product_name] using any supported protocol? 2) Which transceiver module would you recommend for communication with a [version_no] server over distances up to 5km? I couldn't find any communication blocks in the [product_name] software.

Hi [user_name], In the [company_name] catalogue (2010), under Gateways and Interface Converters, there is a KNX/[product_name] gateway for use with [version_no]. The attached catalogue pages may be helpful. Note: This system could be more expensive and require more devices compared to setups using [version_no] and modem combinations.
Have a look at [url]—there are options similar to [product_name]. Perhaps the latest series [article_no] is available?
Hello [user_name], thanks for sharing your file. Do you know how to use Profibus or AS-i as alternatives to KNX?
There isn't a Profibus module available for [product_name]. For AS-i, please check here: [url]. Hope this helps.

Hi [user_name], The DP/EIB Link ([article_no]) will be discontinued as of October 1, 2008 (see announcement ID: 25938281). After this date, it only remains available as a spare part on a turnaround basis, and there is no replacement planned. Further information can be found at this link: [url]

Since the initial question was about a modem for data transfer with [product_name], I would like to mention a radio modem suitable for the current [product_name] [article_no]: "INSYS GSM 4.3 [product_name]" ([article_no]). Note that this modem is not compatible with older versions of [product_name]. Since [product_name] has a unique port (not RS232), you must use a modem officially released for it. For more details, please visit the manufacturer's website: [url]

analysis.insight_summary: Forum participants are discussing various methods of achieving wireless communication between remote [product_name] modules (with analog and digital I/Os) and a central [version_no] PLC over extended distances (~5km). There is some confusion regarding compatible communication modules, supported protocols, and specific programming options within both [product_name] hardware and its programming software for remote usage. Users have noted the lack of dedicated communication function blocks and the absence of modules such as Profibus or AS-i for [product_name], which complicates integration planning for wireless scenarios.
analysis.user_expectations: The user seeks clear, flexible, and reliable long-distance wireless solutions connecting [product_name] modules with more advanced [company_name] PLC systems. They are looking for definitive guidance on supported protocols, compatible wireless modules, and clearly documented configuration/programming options within the [product_name] environment.
